## Operational Area Publication Review

### Submission
- Operator ID:
- Site / Area ID:
- Metro / Locality:
- Source issue:

### Reviewer checklist

#### Geometry
- [ ] Polygon / MultiPolygon is valid GeoJSON.
- [ ] Geometry represents the intended operational area.
- [ ] No unnecessary precision or operational detail is exposed.

#### Minimum necessary information
- [ ] No flight routes or trajectories.
- [ ] No customer information.
- [ ] No flight volumes.
- [ ] No detailed operational strategy.
- [ ] No other commercially sensitive information.

#### Metadata
- [ ] Operator and site identifiers are appropriate.
- [ ] Locality is accurate.
- [ ] Contact information is appropriate for publication, if provided.
- [ ] Effective dates are accurate, if provided.

#### Automated checks
- [ ] Schema / geometry validation passes.
- [ ] Potential overlap has been reviewed as an awareness signal.
- [ ] Any overlap does not imply authorization or a coordination determination.

### Publication decision
- [ ] Approved for publication
- [ ] Changes requested
